seo.title: Instagram DM automation and comment-to-DM | Steps AI
seo.description: Answer Instagram DMs with an AI agent, turn comments into conversations with keywords such as PRICE, and reply to story mentions.

hero.title: Turn Instagram comments and DMs into sales.
hero.body: Your agent answers direct messages, replies to comments with a DM when someone uses a keyword, and picks up story replies and mentions. All from the same agent as your other channels.
hero.reassurance: One Meta connection. Keyword comment-to-DM. Your team can step in.

jobs.title: What your agent does on Instagram.
jobs.intro: Busy launch? The agent keeps up with your DMs.

items.title: Answer direct messages
items.body: Product, size, stock and delivery questions get an answer from your own information.

items.title: Turn comments into DMs
items.body: When someone comments a keyword such as PRICE or LINK, reply in their DMs straight away.

items.title: Reply to stories
items.body: Pick up story replies and mentions as conversations.

items.title: Help customers buy
items.body: Recommend products and share a checkout link in the conversation.

triggers.title: Start more conversations on Instagram.
triggers.intro: Comment triggers can be scoped to one post or Reel.

items.title: Keyword comments
items.body: Choose the words that start a DM, and the reply that goes out.

items.title: Post and Reel triggers
items.body: Run a comment trigger on a single post or Reel, including live comments.

items.title: Quick-reply buttons
items.body: Send buttons that wait for the customer’s choice and branch on it.

items.title: Comment moderation
items.body: Review comments on your connected posts in one place.

items.title: Set your comment triggers
items.body: Add keywords and replies for the posts you want to cover.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Instagram broadcast campaigns are not available. Campaigns run on WhatsApp.
Instagram does not share state-level location for analytics.

items.a: When someone comments a keyword you choose on your post, your agent sends them a direct message, so the conversation can continue privately.

items.q: Do I need a separate setup for WhatsApp and Messenger?
items.a: No. One Meta connection covers Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger.
